description: Guarantees full session capture for every session of the bitdrift-shop-opentelemetry demo app (ai.bitdrift.oteldemo), scoped to that app ID only. Deployed ahead of live demos so every run — including the walkthrough itself — lands a full timeline for playback, instead of relying on a workflow that happened to be watching. Fires on APP_LAUNCH with no sampling and no additional match conditions, so it captures 100% of sessions for this app; it is not narrowed to a single device.
